crossRefs.note: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young…
Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that…
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will…
I will feed them with good pasture; and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will…
Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than…
I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means…
Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the…
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…
As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a…
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

translations.web: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
translations.bsb: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
translations.kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
translations.asv: But we were gentle in the midst of you, as when a nurse cherisheth her own children:
